QuestInfo.name: The Time Sphere
QuestInfo.0: I may need to take care of some more business while creating the time sphere. I should go see #p2041021#.
QuestInfo.2: I found the #t4031179:# that #p2041021# was talking about. Apparently, to defeat Papulatus, we need to be at least level 80 or higher...

0.0: I'm making the Time Sphere as we speak with the materials that you got me. In the meantime, we'll need to find #b#t4031179##k to seal up the cracked dimension in the generator.

yes.0: Nice. Well, I'll need a piece that can effectively seal up the crack in dimension. You should go visit #p2041023# for this, who should be standing on the left side of the Path of Time. Flo should tell you all you need to know about the #b#t4031179##k. You'll need to gather up #t4031179:# from him. \n\n#r1#k #t4031179#

no.0: Simply re-creating Time Sphere will not be enough to supply all the power Ludibrium needs. In order to eliminate the monster that made its way here that abused the power of Time Sphere, you'll need to effectively seal up the cracked dimension it used to enter here in the first place.

1.0: Are you here for #t4031179:#? The Time Sphere should be well on its way, but we still need some time for this.

yes.0: I think this is the right one. I can feel the ultimate force of #o8500002# here...this Time Sphere, as soon as it's finished, must be returned to the power generating room. Until then, we need to destroy the #bTime Sphere#k that provided all that power to #o8500001# and kick #o8500002# out of here. When you are ready to take on this difficult task, let me know. You need to be at least Level 120 to handle this.

item.0: Didn't you get it confirmed by #p2041023#?

quest.0: What the, are you sure you brought the cracked piece of dimension the way it should be brought?
